site.name: Coordenada Geo
site.description: Geographic information analysis with scientific rigour: remote sensing and geoprocessing applied to land and the environment.

hero.eyebrow: For those who see beauty in geographic data
hero.title: We turn geographic data into eureka.
hero.subtitle: We specialise in geographic information analysis: remote sensing and geoprocessing applied to land and the environment, with technical and scientific rigour and clear communication for decision-makers.

capabilities.title: Geospatial information technology
capabilities.body: We combine satellite imagery, field data, statistical analysis and information technology to understand land-use change and its environmental, social and economic impacts, producing information that makes a difference when it's time to decide.

cases.title: See our capabilities in projects
cases.body: Coordenada Geo's platform brings together case studies and projects from our portfolio, with interactive maps and analysis. Access is free.

purpose.title: Shortening the path from data to decision
purpose.body: Geographic data holds answers about health, production, the environment, security and the economy, but those answers only make an impact when someone can see them. Our purpose is to make that moment of discovery easier: to make it simpler to extract, understand and consume the information data holds, so every insight reaches further and informs more decisions.

about.title: Over twenty years of geoprocessing.
about.body: The Coordenada Geo team brings over twenty years of experience in geoprocessing and in developing modelling and analysis technologies for geographic information systems. We apply that knowledge to geographic information analysis, with technical and scientific rigour and clear communication for non-specialists.
bullets: Over 20 years of experience in geoprocessing and geographic information systems.
Development of technologies for geospatial modelling and analysis.
Technical and scientific rigour at every stage: from producing the data to analysing and communicating the results.

items.title: Precision
items.body: Technical and scientific rigour in methods and in how data is represented, so every map, chart and table shows what the data really says.

items.title: Collaboration
items.body: We work together with clients, partners and specialists from other fields, listening to those who will use the information so the analysis answers what really matters.

items.title: Adaptation
items.body: Methods and solutions that adapt to different data types, sectors and analysis needs, and keep evolving.

items.title: Revitalisation
items.body: We prioritise uses with a positive impact on people, ecosystems and territories.
